scope: English-first research on realistic AI monk video avatars such as Yang Mun. The directory has 7 researched profiles and 66 unverified discovery candidates; known illustrated/watercolor storytelling channels are excluded. The full 75-record research archive is retained, not a complete census.
methodology: Include a synthetic monk persona only when a platform/creator disclosure or credible reporting supports that classification. Keep screenshot-only cases marked unverified.
Do not merge accounts on similar names alone. Unknown handles, creators, launch dates, and product URLs remain null with a reason.

Store platform, source URL, capture date, and metric beside each number. Instagram followers, YouTube subscribers, views, seller counters, creator statements, orders, and net profit are different measures.
Summarize video structure without storing full scripts, captions, or downloaded media. Video URLs point to the original platform.
User-provided screenshots are identified as such; their calendar capture date is unknown unless the screenshot itself shows it.

Screenshot-visible handles seed unverified leads. Public metadata is dated and source-linked when read through connected research providers. Direct Instagram probes stopped after its robots notice was reviewed; use authorized/connected data access for continuing collection. Unknown AI origin, creator, language and revenue are not inferred from appearance or audience size.

Audience ordering uses each platform's latest numeric followers/subscribers, never views or historical peaks. All-platform comparisons use the largest single observed audience; cross-platform audiences are not added and may overlap. Provider-rounded figures are labelled in each snapshot status.
